objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: If a family of finite sets is pairwise intersecting and has a member $C$ of size $r$, then it has only finitely many inclusion-minimal finite transversals.
objection.witness: The 'finite blocker' claim is false. Counterexample: E_i = {a_1,...,a_i,b_i} (i≥1) is pairwise intersecting (all contain a_1), has member {a_1,b_1} of size 2, yet has infinitely many inclusion-minimal finite transversals: {a_1}, {b_1,a_2}, {b_1,b_2,a_3}, .... Hence the lemma, and with it the whole finiteness of b_1,...,b_s, is unproved.
